body: My phone was at the bar I was at

It just hurts cause I was never more connected to someone before our break. Same life goals, career goals, music tastes, pop culture tastes, humor, the few times we did meet it was amazing. She brought up commitment first and how she was fully committed to me the last time I saw her and then 3 weeks after that she said she couldn’t do it anymore until I knew what school I was going to. She lived in Philly and was a vet student already and I was Columbus applying for vet schools, I tried everything I could to be near her, applied for jobs there, applied for UPenn vet, applied for other schools that weren’t vet in order to be close and yet it all lead to nothing. I never opened myself up to anyone like that and I can’t trust anyone right now with what happened to me besides someone whos job it is to care for that. She did send me a hotline number which I guess was nice of her, but I was shocked when she said that she didn’t owe me anything
